findings.title: The load test has no explicit CI gate
findings.description: Task 22a says no CI wiring is needed because `testpaths` collects `tests/load/`, but collection alone does not establish that CI runs and gates on this test. Add an explicit CI wiring task so a regression in the listing NFR can fail CI.

findings.title: The load test does not measure the specified command
findings.description: The slice’s success criterion sets the under-one-second target for `sq runs list --all`, but Task 22a times `list_run_summaries(..., include_all=True)`. That omits the command and rendering path, so it does not verify the stated end-to-end target.

findings.title: Commit markers use checkbox formatting
findings.description: The commit lines are written as `- [ ] Commit: ...` rather than standalone plain-line commit markers. This formatting is repeated throughout the file; change those lines to standalone `**Commit**:` markers.
